response: At Wirecutter, we've been testing and reviewing VPN services for years, and we're committed to helping you find the best one for your needs. This guide is for anyone looking to protect their online privacy and security. Before choosing a VPN, consider your primary use case, such as streaming or torrenting, and your budget. We tested over 20 services based on speed, security, and ease of use. Our top pick is Mullvad, which offers strong security features and a no-logs policy. TunnelBear is also great for its user-friendly interface and robust security. While HTTPS and Tor offer additional privacy benefits, a good VPN is usually sufficient for most users. Creating your own VPN is possible but not necessary.
